columns.name: country_key
columns.description: Surrogate key; joins the facts.

columns.name: country_name
columns.description: Country as it appears in the source (e.g. 'United Kingdom', 'EIRE' = Ireland, 'RSA' = South Africa, 'USA').

columns.name: iso_alpha2
columns.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 code (NULL for Channel Islands, European Community, Unspecified, West Indies).

columns.name: region
columns.description: Sales region: 'UK & Ireland', 'Western Europe', 'Southern Europe', 'Nordics', 'Central & Eastern Europe', 'Europe (unspecified)', 'Americas', 'Asia Pacific', 'Middle East', 'Africa', 'Unknown'.
tests: accepted_values ['UK & Ireland', 'Western Europe', 'Southern Europe', 'Nordics', 'Central & Eastern Europe', 'Europe (unspecified)', 'Americas', 'Asia Pacific', 'Middle East', 'Africa', 'Unknown']

columns.name: is_domestic_market
columns.description: True only for United Kingdom.

columns.name: has_sales
columns.description: True when the country has at least one invoice.

dim_customer.name: dim_customer
dim_customer.description: Customer dimension, SCD Type 2 on (country_name, loyalty_tier); one row per version. Built from snap_customer_state; includes an unknown member ('-1').

columns.name: customer_sk
columns.description: Surrogate key of the version (re-keyed). Facts store the version valid at invoice time.
columns.masking: re-keyed (opaque join key; the dbt md5 key is re-identifiable)

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Customer identifier (tokenised). Several rows per customer, one per version.
columns.masking: tokenised as cust_<hash> for analyst/viewer; clear only with approval

columns.name: country_name
columns.description: Country of the customer's most recent invoice as of this version.

columns.name: loyalty_tier
columns.description: Tier from cumulative net merchandise spend in GBP: bronze < 1,000 <= silver < 5,000 <= gold < 20,000 <= platinum. 'unknown' = guest member '-1'.

columns.name: version_number
columns.description: 1 = first version.

columns.name: valid_from
columns.description: Inclusive start of validity; version 1 starts 1900-01-01.

columns.name: valid_to
columns.description: Exclusive end of validity; 9999-12-31 for the current version.

columns.name: is_current
columns.description: True for the current version of each customer. Filter on it to count customers once.

columns.name: first_invoice_at
columns.description: Timestamp of the customer's first invoice.

dim_customer.grain: one row per customer version (SCD Type 2); about 5,900 customers, 8,900 versions
notes: To count customers, use count(distinct customer_id) or filter is_current = true; counting rows counts versions.

dim_date.name: dim_date
dim_date.description: Calendar dimension, one row per day 2009-01-01..2012-12-31.

columns.name: date_key
columns.description: Integer yyyymmdd.

columns.name: date_day
columns.description: The date.

columns.name: calendar_year
columns.description: Year.

columns.name: calendar_quarter
columns.description: Quarter 1-4.

columns.name: month_of_year
columns.description: Month 1-12.

columns.name: month_name
columns.description: Month name (January ...).

columns.name: year_month
columns.description: Text 'YYYY-MM'.

columns.name: first_day_of_month
columns.description: First day of the month (date).

columns.name: day_of_week_iso
columns.description: 1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday.

columns.name: day_name
columns.description: Day name (Monday ...).

columns.name: is_weekend
columns.description: True on Saturday and Sunday.

dim_date.grain: one row per calendar day, 2009-01-01 to 2012-12-31

dim_product.name: dim_product
dim_product.description: Product dimension (SCD Type 1), one row per stock code.

columns.name: product_key
columns.description: Surrogate key; joins fct_order_lines.product_key.

columns.name: stock_code
columns.description: Product code from the source system (e.g. 85123A).

columns.name: product_description
columns.description: Canonical description (the one most used on priced sale lines). Free text from the source system.

columns.name: product_category
columns.description: 'merchandise' or a non-product category: postage, fee, manual_adjustment, gift_voucher, discount, samples, test, bad_debt.

columns.name: is_merchandise
columns.description: True for real products. Revenue metrics count merchandise only.

columns.name: avg_sale_price
columns.description: Average unit price over priced sale lines (GBP).

columns.name: first_seen_at
columns.description: First invoice with this product.

columns.name: last_seen_at
columns.description: Last invoice with this product.

fct_order_lines.name: fct_order_lines
fct_order_lines.description: Transaction fact at invoice-line grain (incremental, unique_key = order_line_id). Includes sales, cancellations (negative quantities), stock write-offs and non-product lines so revenue reconciles to silver to the penny; filter with line_type and dim_product.is_merchandise.

columns.name: order_line_id
columns.masking: re-keyed (opaque join key; the dbt md5 key is re-identifiable)

columns.name: invoice_id
columns.description: Invoice number. Prefix 'C' = cancellation invoice, 'A' = bad-debt adjustment.

columns.name: date_key
columns.description: Invoice date as an integer yyyymmdd; joins dim_date.date_key.

columns.name: customer_sk
columns.description: Customer *version* (SCD2) valid at invoice_ts; joins dim_customer.customer_sk. Gives the loyalty tier and country the customer had at the time of sale. '-1' = guest checkout.
columns.masking: re-keyed (opaque join key; the dbt md5 key is re-identifiable)

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Customer identifier (tokenised); NULL for guest checkouts.
columns.masking: tokenised as cust_<hash> for analyst/viewer; clear only with approval

columns.name: product_key
columns.description: Joins dim_product.product_key.

columns.name: country_key
columns.description: Country of the invoice (shipping country); joins dim_country.country_key.

columns.name: invoice_ts
columns.description: Invoice timestamp (one timestamp per invoice). Data covers 2009-12-01 to 2011-12-09.

columns.name: line_type
columns.description: 'sale', 'cancellation' (negative quantity and revenue), 'stock_write_off' (inventory write-off, priced 0) or 'bad_debt_adjustment'.

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Units on the line; negative for cancellations and write-offs.

columns.name: unit_price
columns.description: Price per unit in GBP.

columns.name: line_revenue
columns.description: quantity * unit_price in GBP (negative for cancellations). Sum over merchandise lines with line_type in ('sale','cancellation') = net merchandise revenue.

columns.name: is_quantity_outlier
columns.description: True when |quantity| >= 10,000 (15 bulk lines in the real data).

columns.name: _batch_id
columns.description: Load batch (monthly file) that delivered the line. Lineage only.

columns.name: _ingested_at
columns.description: Load timestamp (incremental watermark). Lineage only; use invoice_ts for business time.

fct_order_lines.grain: one row per distinct invoice line (1 invoice has many lines)
notes: Includes non-merchandise lines (postage, fees, manual adjustments); join dim_product and filter is_merchandise = true for product revenue.
Revenue by customer tier at the time of sale = join dim_customer on customer_sk; by the customer's current tier = join on customer_id with is_current.

fct_orders.name: fct_orders
fct_orders.description: Order (invoice) grain aggregate of fct_order_lines, for order-level questions (order counts, average order value, basket size).

columns.name: invoice_id
columns.description: Invoice number (unique).

columns.name: customer_sk
columns.description: Customer version at invoice time; joins dim_customer.customer_sk.
columns.masking: re-keyed (opaque join key; the dbt md5 key is re-identifiable)

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Customer identifier (tokenised); NULL for guest checkouts.
columns.masking: tokenised as cust_<hash> for analyst/viewer; clear only with approval

columns.name: country_key
columns.description: Joins dim_country.country_key.

columns.name: date_key
columns.description: Invoice date yyyymmdd; joins dim_date.date_key.

columns.name: invoice_ts
columns.description: Invoice timestamp.

columns.name: invoice_type
columns.description: 'sale', 'cancellation', 'bad_debt_adjustment' or 'stock_write_off'.

columns.name: n_lines
columns.description: Number of lines on the invoice.

columns.name: n_distinct_products
columns.description: Distinct products on the invoice.

columns.name: total_units
columns.description: Sum of quantity over the invoice's lines.

columns.name: invoice_revenue
columns.description: Sum of line_revenue over all lines, including postage and fees (GBP).

columns.name: merchandise_revenue
columns.description: Sum of line_revenue over merchandise lines only (GBP).

columns.name: has_quantity_outlier
columns.description: True when any line is a bulk-quantity outlier.

mart_cohort_retention.name: mart_cohort_retention
mart_cohort_retention.description: Acquisition-cohort retention matrix in long format.

columns.name: cohort_month
columns.description: Month of the customer's first sale (date).

columns.name: months_since_first_purchase
columns.description: 0 = the cohort month itself.

columns.name: cohort_size
columns.description: Customers whose first sale was in cohort_month.

columns.name: active_customers
columns.description: Cohort customers who bought in that month.

columns.name: retention_rate
columns.description: active_customers / cohort_size (0..1).

columns.name: is_left_censored_cohort
columns.description: True for the first cohort (Dec 2009), which holds every customer whose history began before the data did.

mart_cohort_retention.grain: one row per (acquisition cohort month, months since first purchase)

mart_revenue_monthly.name: mart_revenue_monthly
mart_revenue_monthly.description: Monthly revenue KPIs (gross, cancellations, net, AOV) with MoM / YoY growth.

columns.name: revenue_month
columns.description: First day of the month (date).

columns.name: n_orders
columns.description: Distinct sale invoices in the month.

columns.name: n_active_customers
columns.description: Distinct customers with a sale line in the month (guests excluded).

columns.name: gross_merchandise_sales
columns.description: Merchandise sale lines, GBP.

columns.name: cancelled_merchandise
columns.description: Merchandise cancellation lines, GBP (negative).

columns.name: net_merchandise_revenue
columns.description: gross_merchandise_sales + cancelled_merchandise, GBP. The certified "revenue".

columns.name: non_merchandise_amount
columns.description: Postage, fees, manual adjustments, bad debt, vouchers, GBP.

columns.name: total_net_amount
columns.description: Everything (net merchandise + non-merchandise), GBP. Reconciles to sum(fct_order_lines.line_revenue).

columns.name: avg_order_value
columns.description: net_merchandise_revenue / n_orders, GBP.

columns.name: mom_growth
columns.description: Month-over-month growth of net_merchandise_revenue (0.10 = +10%).

columns.name: yoy_growth
columns.description: Growth vs the same month a year earlier (NULL in the first 12 months).

columns.name: ytd_net_revenue
columns.description: Year-to-date net merchandise revenue, GBP.

columns.name: is_partial_month
columns.description: True when the data ends before the month does (December 2011 ends on 2011-12-09).

mart_revenue_monthly.grain: one row per calendar month, 2009-12 to 2011-12
